title: SMART_B – Smart Energy and Management Optimization for Buildings
excerpt: The SMART_B project aims to develop a digital environment for managing building data, linked to BIM and IoT. This digital environment will integrate an intelligence engine to optimize the operation, exploitation and management of buildings (BMS).
content:
The SMART_B project aims to develop a digital environment for managing building data, linked to BIM and IoT. This digital environment will integrate an intelligence engine to optimize the operation, exploitation and management of buildings (BMS).

The platform that has been developed uses different data sources (mobility sensors, air quality sensors, temperature sensors, lighting sensors, etc.) to understand the dynamics of buildings and propose appropriate building behaviors and uses.

This tool is in operation at the BUILT CoLAB office in Porto and allows for the management of the physical space in all its dimensions (lighting, heating, sensors, printers, consumption, etc.) and advanced monitoring.

SmartOffice

A set of devices (sensorbox) and control software (Node-RED, Grafana, InfluxDB) that enhance control and observability over the office, including consumption, environmental conditions and alerts.

MQTTdash

A tool for easily generating dashboards to control intelligent buildings, available in open source and based on web technologies.

Main Activities

  • IoT integration with BIM and an office DT (SmartOffice)
  • Platform development (MQTTdash)
  • Development and implementation of building intelligence engines.

Synergies

  • Mobilizing Project REV@CONSTRUCTION
